scope: Fresh read-only static disassembly of selected ordinary native branches in the installed official client. No game execution, tests, or runtime XLua override verification. Native implementation structure is evidence for the selected methods, not proof of a project API requirement or all reachable content combinations.

tool.writePolicy: Only this evidence JSON was written by this extraction; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 was set.

evidenceBoundary: XLua delegate branches are retained in the disassembly, but their runtime installation and bodies were not verified.
Selected setters and post-cast behaviours prove specific state changes; they do not establish an arbitrary scalar priority pipeline.
The ordered behaviour loop in BasicSkill.PostprocessData is not by itself a formula or priority contract for SP capacity, requirement, payment or TIME duration.
No inference that the Attribute four-part reduction applies to these distinct Skill parameters is made.
